claude.sample_unit: patients (154 training cohort, 229 external validation cohort)
models_evaluated: logistic regression nomogram (age, obesity, SOFA, HR, HACOR at 24 h)

links.outcome: Nomogram discrimination (AUC) in development cohort versus external ICU cohort
links.effect: Training AUC 0.89 (CI 0.839-0.942); external validation AUC 0.547 (CI 0.449-0.645); NIV failure 37.6% vs 18%.
links.quote: The model's HL test result was 0.861, with an AUC of 0.89 (confidence interval [CI] 0.839-0.942); validation AUC was 0.547 (CI 0.449-0.645).

links.outcome: Performance drop when applying model to a different ICU population
links.effect: Model discriminated well in the development cohort (AUC 0.89) but poorly in the external cohort (AUC 0.547), with differing NIV failure rates (37.6% vs 18%).
links.quote: A predictive model using age, obesity, SOFA score, HR, and HACOR at 24 h predicts NIV failure in our COVID-19 patients but may not apply to other ICUs.
